question: Under which fixed-truth transit/noise regimes does the shared physical workflow recover parameters and deliver nominal equal-tailed interval coverage?
hypothesis: Supported white-noise regimes may exhibit coverage compatible with nominal levels within finite-replication precision; weak identification and correlated misspecification may cause biased or uncalibrated posteriors despite numerical convergence.
replication_precision: Four unchanged white-noise regimes with 100 NEW independent datasets each. Binomial SE at p=.50/.80/.94 is .050/.040/.02375 (planning values, not measured results); report Wilson95 intervals and all declared failures. Precision improves but n=100 does not establish exact calibration.
pilot_exclusion: All pilot_* attempts excluded from final claims and final coverage denominators. Debugging/timing only, all retained.
scenario_selection: Predefined regime grid, not a factorial causal experiment: depth, SNR, cadence, impact and jitter vary jointly. Controlled causal comparisons belong to PUB-04. OU cases share shallow white truth/design except correlated stochastic perturbation.

scenarios.regime: Kepler-10-like shallow radius scale; not identical observational cadence/selection
near/below useful detection SNR, high impact, long cadence, extra white noise

generative_model.physical: Circular orbit, quadratic limb darkening, exposure-integrated exoplanet primitive with 31 midpoint quadrature nodes
generative_model.measurement: Independent Gaussian known heteroscedastic sigma_i: linear .8-to-1.2 times scenario scale per segment
generative_model.jitter: Independent additional zero-mean Gaussian with declared true SD
generative_model.correlation: OU within each segment: covariance amplitude^2 exp(-abs(delta_t)/timescale); gaps evolve over real elapsed time, segments independent
generative_model.normalization: Known calibration in core simulations; no claim of empirical Gold normalization validation from P2 alone
generative_model.anti_circularity: Shared physical primitive explicitly acknowledged. Analytic tests and independent batman forward checks required before final; PUB03 supplies independent posterior implementation evidence. No inference process opens truth.json.

inference.known_design_assumptions: Period, time convention, exposure, segment and measurement errors known. Fixed truth r,b,a,t0,jitter,q1,q2 are not used to set priors or initialize chains.

inference_assumptions.likelihood: Independent Gaussian(mu_transit + baseline, sqrt(measured_sigma_i^2 + extra_sigma^2)); no temporal covariance
inference_assumptions.orbit: circular, period fixed; a/Rs Uniform(2,50), b Uniform(0,1), so grazing b>1 is outside supported prior domain
inference_assumptions.radius: LogNormal(log(.04), .9), same population-scale reference for ALL scenarios, not truth-matched
inference_assumptions.t0: Normal(0,.025) days, same across all scenarios
inference_assumptions.jitter: HalfNormal(max(5 median(measured_sigma), .0005)) normalized flux; data-scale rule declared, not truth-informed
inference_assumptions.sampler: PyMC NUTS, jitter+adapt_diag, one attempt per identity, no automatic retries or alternative seeds
inference_assumptions.derived: depth=r^2 geometric; T14=P/pi asin(sqrt(((1+r)^2-b^2)/(a^2-b^2))) in days

seed_policy: publication.campaign_plan.seed: first32bits of canonical SHA256 ['campaign-seed-v1',campaign_id,experiment_id,scenario_id,replicate_id,stream]. PUB-04 generation substitutes pair_id for scenario_id. Frozen integer ledger is authoritative. Retries retain seeds; different campaigns have separate namespaces.

gates.provenance: Exact input SHA256 and content-derived synthetic dataset ID, committed protocol and complete predeclared registry; no existing-run overwrite
gates.sampler: All scalar sampled/derived summary Rhat<=1.01; bulk/tail ESS>=400; zero divergences; BFMI>=.30. Record tree-depth saturation separately; no numerical repair by deleting draws.
gates.inherited_ppc: Observed fraction in posterior predictive 94% intervals within [.80,.99], standardized residual SD within [.5,2]; broad screening not an exact calibration test
gates.temporal_ppc: No within-segment cadence-contiguous residual correlation at lags1-5 beyond normal Bonferroni reference z_(1-.01/10)/sqrt(Npairs). Approximate fitted-residual screen; false positives/negatives measured, not assumed controlled exactly.
gates.scale: Inherited M5 jitter/median_error<=20 and <=5% posterior r outside inherited review interval [.00349,.24751]. This interval is a heuristic scientific review range, not LogNormal support.
gates.promotion: Separate provenance, sampler, PPC and final scientific interpretability. Aggregate negative findings can use rejected runs with explicit classification; positive individual claims require all relevant gates.

inclusion: Every declared scenario and replicate; no exclusion based on posterior, sampler, gate, seed or favorable recovery
exclusion: Pilots excluded by mode; no data-dependent final exclusions
failure_policy: All failures remain versioned and count in operational denominators. Missing posterior intervals are missing, not measured noncoverage. Report raw numeric, sampler-conditioned, final-gate-conditioned coverage with separate denominators, and covered-and-passed/all-declared operational rate. No best retry.
statistical_interpretation: Fixed-truth conditional repeated-sampling coverage, NOT SBC. Compare estimated frequency with nominal with Wilson95, descriptive across all seven parameters/scenarios; no unadjusted many-test discovery claims. Persistent severe undercoverage means failure of conditional operating performance, not proof of a sampler bug. Large widths may yield coverage but poor precision.
hypothesis_rejection: If a supported white regime has precise material bias or undercoverage, cannot claim adequate recovery there. If sampler fails systematically, numerical validity is unresolved. If gates pass known biased/misspecified runs, report false negatives. No threshold tuning to observational agreement.
invalidation: Truth leakage, incorrect generative signal, wrong likelihood, mutated protocol/data, or incorrect aggregation invalidates affected attempts scientifically; retain originals, log amendment, new run IDs only.

amendments.reason: User imposed 36h compute ceiling and TCC deadline; pilot timing only, never posterior quality, determines replication reduction.

amendments.stage: after parent final results, before any confirmatory final attempt
amendments.reason: User-authorized independent equal-N precision extension with 100 new replicates per each of the four original scenarios. No scientific model or gate changes; parent remains frozen.

freeze_note: Prospective specification for tcc_calibration_confirmatory_v1. The original tcc_campaign_v1 results were already inspected. This extension was authorized after that campaign; only the new fixed-N cohort supplies primary confirmatory estimates. Protocol and integer seed ledger must be committed before its first inference.
temporal_diagnostic_scope: Within-segment gap-filtered selected-observation lags1-5, not native cadence after thinning. Spacing proxy is median selected time gap. Degenerate/nonfinite/insufficient pairs are unavailable; positive PPC requires at least one finite evaluable lag and no flagged lag. This does not establish absence of correlations at unobserved timescales.

deferred_scenarios.regime: shallow transit, weak stationary temporal correlation; M5 misspecified
shallow transit, strong stationary temporal correlation; M5 misspecified

deferred_scenario_reason: The extension repeats all four originally selected white-noise regimes equally. OU scenarios remain deferred and M6 is disabled. No correlated-noise calibration claim from this cohort; completed observational/PPC failures in tcc_campaign_v1 remain part of the overall evidence.

confirmatory_extension.rationale: User authorized more compute after the initial 20-per-scenario campaign completed. Equal fixed-N extension improves precision of conditional coverage/bias and failure rates. All original scenarios retained; no outcome-dependent parameter, prior, gate or sampler change.
confirmatory_extension.outcome_knowledge: Parent coverage, bias, gate outcomes, external benchmark and multi-target rejections were inspected before this extension. It is not preregistration of the already observed parent results.
confirmatory_extension.primary_cohort: Only the 400 newly declared runs (100 per scenario); new deterministic campaign seed namespace, no re-use of parent draws or data.
confirmatory_extension.secondary_comparison: Report new and parent cohorts separately under the same metrics, including all rejected/failed/missing runs. Any later pooled analysis must be explicitly secondary and disclose extension after parent outcomes; never replace primary new-cohort results.
confirmatory_extension.stopping_rule: Fixed 100 attempts per scenario; no significance-, coverage-, bias- or gate-dependent stopping, sample-size adaptation, seed replacement or best-run selection. If the 22h soft budget stops dispatch, finish active work and preserve remaining jobs as PLANNED; report incomplete until the frozen remainder is resumed. No automatic cap increase.
confirmatory_extension.statistical_scope: Conditional repeated-sampling coverage at four fixed truths, not SBC, population inference, or evidence that the white likelihood handles correlated noise.
confirmatory_extension.resource_policy: One inference at a time, four chains and four cores; unchanged sampler. Automatic scientific retries disabled.
